name: ABC one-off items and event month

source.derivation: Hand-computed from cached cell values; not produced by the adapter.
source.notes: One-off = detail row non-zero in exactly one of the 18 months with |amount| >= 5,000. Dec 2025 is the event month: I101 and I99 turn Total OPEX negative and make Net Income the only positive month. Excluding them: I107 - I101 - I99 = 534,551.41 + 1,244,429.84 - 334,660.53 = -375,217.90. Income Tax Benefit sits inside Operating Expenses in the source (row 101); flag as a mapping question.

grading: Exact set of one-off accounts and months; amounts within 0.005; event month is the only month with positive net income.
